businesses.business: oilfield drilling tool rental and sales

offering_description.value: Rents and sells downhole drilling tools and related equipment to oil and gas exploration and production companies and directional drilling service providers. It also provides inspection, repair and directional drilling tool services from a network of service locations.

primary_products.value: downhole drilling tools; drill pipe and drill string components; directional drilling tools; used and new tool sales

primary_services.value: drilling tool rental; tool inspection and repair; directional drilling services; fishing and wellbore services

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas operators, drilling contractors and directional drilling service companies

end_markets.value: oil and gas exploration and production; directional and horizontal drilling; geothermal

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: rental of downhole drilling tools to drillers and operators; product sales: sales of new and used drilling tools; service fees: inspection, repair and directional drilling services
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and rents a fleet of drilling tools to drillers and operators; service provider: inspects, repairs and supports tools and wellbore operations for oilfield customers; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures some proprietary tools sold or rented to oilfield customers
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; service provider; OEM / manufacturer

geography_served.value: global: United States shale basins plus Canada, Latin America, Europe, Middle East and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: tool rentals, tool sales and directional drilling services for drilling operations

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales and rental staff serving operators and drilling contractors; own locations: service and rental facilities in oil-producing regions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: oilfield operations subject to environmental, safety (OSHA) and international trade rules
